claim: Incremental predictive rank utility of fixed graph-derived representations under one frozen ridge learner; no new information beyond the source graph, no causal identification or universal geometry score.

dream4.input: full unsigned directed native gold-standard topology; source IDs/hashes and all expression values excluded from predictors
dream4.contrastTraining: fit and tune separately; no KO/KD pooling or transfer claim
dream4.target: absolute(perturbed expression - corresponding wildtype expression), rank within intervention
dream4.normalization: none before ranking; no division, logarithm, pseudocount or noise floor
dream4.primaryCoverage: all five networks, all ten interventions and all nine off-target genes per intervention; each intervention population must have at least two distinct magnitudes; otherwise primary unavailable before fitting
dream4.secondaryCoverage: eligible-only summaries separately labelled with exact denominators; never replace strict primary
dream4.averaging: mean of ten intervention rankSkill values within network, then equal mean over all five networks
dream4.graphProbeFailures: graph-edit probe rejection or budget failure does not exclude independent biological KO/KD targets

celegans.anatomyReason: first author-indexed adult anatomical unit, fixed without comparative predictive results
celegans.channel: witvliet-neuron-chemical-simple-v1; gap junctions remain a separate unused channel
celegans.scope: D2 closed weak one-hop induced chemical neighborhood rooted at the stimulus; require entire rooted scope to pass common provider preparation; no truncation
celegans.scopePopulation: all 180 anatomical neuronal endpoints retained in the root census; all 5808 native stimulus rows accounted for by aggregate D3 exclusions and retained by identity in the bound D2 artifact; D5 retains event-level mapping/window/receiver exclusions; 29 prepared anatomical roots are candidates, not independent animals
celegans.mapping: D2 exact-label candidates accepted operationally only when one trace column exactly names an individual neuron in the chosen anatomy; trim outer whitespace only; no aliases or class expansion; not an identity-confidence certificate
celegans.target: absolute((mean processed exported receiver signal [t,t+30s) - mean [t-30s,t)) / mean [t-30s,t))
celegans.windows: exact 0.5s native grid, 60 finite samples in each window, strictly positive baseline; no new interpolation or source-quality inference
eventExclusions: any other native stimulation in [t-30s,t+30s), including negative-index rows
celegans.pairAggregation: median magnitudes over eligible trials per recording/source/receiver, then median of those recording medians per source/receiver
celegans.pairEligibility: at least two distinct source recordings with an eligible magnitude; unavailable-only pairs retained explicitly
celegans.rankEligibility: at least three eligible receiver neurons in the rooted scope with at least two distinct magnitudes; rank only this fixed observed target population
celegans.outerSplit: leave-one-stimulated-neuron-out across every recording, receiver and repeated trial
celegans.averaging: equal mean over all eligible stimulated-neuron groups; no pairwise IID uncertainty or new-animal generalization
celegans.sourceQuality: processed/interpolated export; original nan_mask, per-column processing lineage, target-hit/autoresponse criteria and unstimulated controls absent; source-paper q-values and quality selection not reproducible; publication code snapshots do not establish the exact installed software/flags used to produce the archive
celegans.claim: descriptive held-out-source-neuron association with processed signal following recorded/attempted stimulation; anatomical and functional animals differ
celegans.dependence: transductive on one fixed anatomy; receiver neurons and recordings may be shared across source-neuron folds; no unseen-animal or unseen-graph claim

metrics.primary: rankSkill=(concordant-discordant)/(concordant+discordant+prediction-only-ties) over unequal observed target pairs; prediction ties contribute zero
metrics.targetTies: exact binary64 numeric equality, one-based average ranks; no epsilon
metrics.undefined: constant observed target or fewer than two values gives null, never zero; nonconstant targets with constant predictions give rankSkill zero by definition
secondary: Spearman rho with exact centered rank integer components
Kendall tau-b with explicit tie counts

learner.lambdaSelection: maximize mean inner-group rankSkill on identical declared validation populations; exact tie chooses largest lambda
learner.transforms: weighted training-only means and population standard deviations; constant training columns set to zero for all splits; no target/test rows in fitting, tuning or normalization
learner.weights: equal training groups, then equal interventions in group, then equal eligible receivers
learner.failures: no fallback model, sampled tuning grid or altered fold; numeric failure makes requested primary unavailable with retained diagnostics

baselines.standalone: sum(2^-k * P^k(source,target),k=1..4), row-normalized directed adjacency with zero sink rows
baselines.regressionBaseline: all 23 fixed graph features; same scoped input as geometry

geometry.population: same exact nodes and edges for every requested family; all certificates verified against expected source and request

edgeFields.ollivier: exact half-idleness unit Ollivier curvature on every scoped edge

sixCoordinatesPerField: mean over incoming edges at source
mean over outgoing edges at source
mean over incoming edges at target
mean over outgoing edges at target
mean over distinct edges in the union of all unit-hop shortest source-to-target paths
geometry.emptySets: known structural absence gives zero sentinel masked by baseline degrees/direct_edge/unreachable; missing or invalid numerical evidence never gives zero
geometry.shortestUnion: edge (u,v) belongs iff hop(s,u)+1+hop(v,t)=hop(s,t); count each edge once, not once per path
flowAdditional: actual terminal weighted directed shortest source-to-target distance; zero only if baseline unreachable=1
geometry.flowCoverage: terminal-event profile uses only actual certified states; retain stop reason; no padded fixed horizon and no convergence claim at iteration cap
geometry.numeric: aggregate rational fields exactly before one finite binary64 conversion; reject overflow/underflow; no interval midpoints

ablations.primaryComparison: B+F+O+flow minus B on exactly the same target-eligible and fully verified geometry population
ablations.coverage: eligibility fixed jointly for all ablations before fitting; disclose full native population and every exclusion separately; prediction ties never remove observations

reporting.primary: equal-group mean paired rankSkill difference for each study separately; no combined DREAM4/C.elegans score
reporting.uncertainty: report complete group vectors, min/max and leave-one-group-out aggregate range as descriptive sensitivity, not confidence intervals; overlapping training folds and shared neurons prohibit IID pair inference
reporting.negativePolicy: mean delta <= 0 is no observed gain for this pipeline; positive mean is limited representation gain with per-group heterogeneity, not statistical or biological generality
reporting.indeterminate: insufficient predeclared groups/targets or missing required computations leaves primary null with reasons, not a zero/positive result
reporting.costs: record preprocessing, geometry, fitting and inference timings/peak resources separately from semantic identity; record graph, target and feature counts and exclusions
reporting.disclosure: publish zero/negative results and all declared ablations; no outcome-selected replacements

robustness.gate: D6, after primary pilot; never used to tune D4/D5 primary
robustness.degreeNull: 32 indexed directed double-edge-swap nulls per parent/scope; preserve each labelled node in/out degree and weak component membership; reject loops/parallel arcs; no channel mixing
robustness.nullSampler: Null indices 0..31, proposal counters 0..4095; UTF-8 SHA256 of JSON.stringify(["onto2d-biological-rank-null-v1",datasetId,scopeRootOrNull,originalGraphSha256,nullIndex,proposalCounter]); originalGraphSha256 is the lowercase unprefixed D2 scope graph hash; sort current ordered edges lexicographically by source then target using ECMAScript UTF-16 string order before each proposal; first and second uint32 big-endian digest words modulo edge count choose edges; discard equal indices; propose (a,b),(c,d)->(a,d),(c,b); accept only changed simple loopless edge set preserving the original labelled weak-component partition; stop at 10*m accepted swaps or 4096 proposals, with fewer than 10*m marked unavailable; empty graphs unavailable; duplicate sampled graphs retained with multiplicity; not a uniform graph null
robustness.nullEvaluation: recompute every baseline/geometry and all nested fits with the same unchanged independent targets; retain every failed/null scope; no calibrated p-value claim
sensitivity: provider, idleness and initial-length changes as separately versioned secondary profiles

implementedAtD3: grouped folds and weighted ridge helpers
source-bound protocol and independent synthetic references
implementationBoundary.next: D4 must implement verified pair-geometry collection and complete nested evaluation exactly under this protocol; D5 applies the functional extraction contract without silent quality upgrades
